claim: The redesigned UI remains usable at required landscape sizes and safe areas.
artifact_or_command: godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/run_battle_hud_screen_tests.gd; godot --headless --path project-a -s tools/run_legion_screen_tests.gd; project-a/artifacts/ui-legion-844x390.png

grader.name: battle HUD and legion responsive assertions

observation: 战斗关键按钮在 844×390 与 568×320 内保持可见；军团页在 844×390 首屏完整显示 2×3 阵型，成员培养页仍满足 App Shell 高度和 48px 动作目标。
inference: 当前高频界面满足自动响应式门槛，紧凑化没有以牺牲触控目标为代价。
limitations: 未覆盖 iOS Safari 实机安全区和真实手指遮挡。
